records.jp: あ！　日菜子ちゃん
records.en_original: Ah! Hinako.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, Hinako!
records.en: Ah! Hinako-chan.

records.jp: しほり。今日も元気そうだね
records.en_original: Shihori. You're as lively as ever.
records.en_auxiliary: Shihori. You seem as upbeat as ever.
records.en: Shihori. You're as lively as ever.

records.jp: うん！
records.en_original: Yup!
records.en_auxiliary: Of course!
records.en: Yup!

records.jp: それにしても日菜子ちゃんから話しかけてくれるなんて<CR>もしかして下着交換してくれる気になったの？
records.en_original: But, given that you're approaching me... Have you finally decided to swap underwear with me?
records.en_auxiliary: But since you decided to approach me... Have you also finally decided to swap underwear with me?
records.en: But I'm surprised you approached me, Hinako-chan.<CR>Have you finally decided to swap underwear with me?

records.jp: 違う
records.en_original: Nope.
records.en_auxiliary: Nope.
records.en: Nope.

records.jp: それじゃあ、何なのか――
records.en_original: Then what could it...
records.en_auxiliary: Then what could it...
records.en: Then what could it...

records.jp: なっ！
records.en_original: Be!
records.en_auxiliary: Be!
records.en: Be!

records.jp: ほう……
records.en_original: Hm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Hm...

records.jp: キャアー！　何また見てるの！
records.en_original: Aaah! Why are you doing this again!?
records.en_auxiliary: Aaah! Why are you doing this again?!
records.en: Aaah! Why are you doing this again!?

records.jp: だって、気になるじゃない？<CR>それに女子同士なんだから見られてもいいでしょ
records.en_original: Because I'm curious. Besides, we're both girls, it's fine if I look.
records.en_auxiliary: Because I'm curious. Besides, we're both girls. There's nothing wrong with it. It's fine.
records.en: Because I'm curious. Besides, we're both girls, it's fine if I look.

records.jp: 見られるのもだけど、覗かれるのが嫌なの！
records.en_original: It's NOT fine, and peeping is worse!
records.en_auxiliary: It's NOT fine, and peeping is worse!
records.en: It's NOT fine, and peeping is worse!

records.jp: えー……
records.en_original: Whaaat...
records.en_auxiliary: Whaaat?!
records.en: Whaaat...

records.jp: （この子……）
records.en_original: (This girl...)
records.en_auxiliary: (This girl...)
records.en: (This girl...)

records.jp: なっ！
records.en_original: Be!
records.en_auxiliary: Be!
records.en: Be!

records.jp: うー……さすがね日菜子ちゃん。<CR>今日は見えなかったよ
records.en_original: Oof... Oh, you're good, Hinako. I didn't even catch a glimpse.
records.en_auxiliary: Oof! Oh, you're quick, Hinako. I didn't even get a good glimpse.
records.en: Oof... Oh, you're good, Hinako-chan. I didn't even catch a glimpse.

records.jp: （ふう……よかった……）
records.en_original: (Whew... Good.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Whew. Good.)
records.en: (Whew... Good.)

records.jp: それで、用事はなんなのかな？
records.en_original: Anyway, what did you want from me?
records.en_auxiliary: Anyway, what did you want from me?
records.en: Anyway, what did you want from me?

records.jp: え、えーと……ちょっと聞きたいことがあって……
records.en_original: W-well... There's something I wanted to ask...
records.en_auxiliary: W-well... There's something I wanted to ask.
records.en: W-well... There's something I wanted to ask...

records.jp: 私、前々から気になってたんだけど……その……<CR>しほりってなんでそんなにオシャレにこだわるの？
records.en_original: I've been curious for a while, but... Well... Why are you so focused on fashion?
records.en_auxiliary: I've been curious for a while, but... Well... Why are you so focused on fashion?
records.en: I've been curious for a while, but... Well... Why are you so focused on fashion?

records.jp: なんか、キレイになりたい気持ちだけで<CR>ここまでやれるのかなって思って……
records.en_original: I don't think anyone would go this far just because she wants to be a little prettier.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think anyone would go this far just because she wants to be a little prettier.
records.en: I don't think anyone would go this far just because she wants to be a little prettier.

records.jp: うーん……。なんでかな？<CR>ここまでこだわるようになった理由だよね……？
records.en_original: Hm... That is a good question. You want a reason why I became this focused, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... That is a good question. You want a reason why I got this into it, right?
records.en: Hm... That is a good question. You want a reason why I became this focused, right?

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: 気づいたら、今みたいになっていたっていうのが<CR>一番あってるような気がするけど……
records.en_original: I was like this before I realized it, would be the best way of putting it, but...
records.en_auxiliary: To be honest, I didn't turn out this way on purpose. What should I say?
records.en: I was like this before I realized it, would be the best way of putting it, but...

records.jp: しいて言うなら、子供の時の経験かも……
records.en_original: If I had to pinpoint something in particular, it might be a childhood experience...
records.en_auxiliary: If I had to pinpoint something in particular, it might have been a childhood experience.
records.en: If I had to pinpoint something in particular, it might be a childhood experience...

records.jp: それってどんな？
records.en_original: What was that?
records.en_auxiliary: What was that?
records.en: What was that?

records.jp: 実は私、小さいころはオシャレに<CR>そこまで興味があったわけじゃないの……
records.en_original: To tell the truth, I wasn't this interested in fashion back when I was a little kid...
records.en_auxiliary: To tell the truth, I wasn't this interested in fashion back when I was a little kid.
records.en: To tell the truth, I wasn't this interested in fashion back when I was a little kid...

records.jp: ううん……。正確に言えば、<CR>自分がオシャレに興味があることに気づいてなかったの……
records.en_original: No... It'd be more accurate to say I just hadn't realized I was this interested...
records.en_auxiliary: No. It'd be more accurate to say that I hadn't realized I was this interested YET.
records.en: No... It'd be more accurate to say I just hadn't realized I was this interested...

records.jp: そうなんだ。私はてっきり、しほりは小さいころから<CR>かわいい服とか着てオシャレしてたのかと思ったよ
records.en_original: I see. I just assumed you were wearing cute clothes and accessorizing since you were a little kid.
records.en_auxiliary: I see. I assumed you were wearing cute clothes and accessorizing since you could walk.
records.en: I see. I just assumed you were wearing cute clothes and accessorizing since you were a little kid.

records.jp: ううん……。<CR>私も小さいころはお母さんが買ってきた服を普通に着てたよ
records.en_original: Not at all... When I was little, I just wore the clothes my mom bought me, like anyone else.
records.en_auxiliary: Not at all. When I was little, I wore the clothes my mom bought me like anyone else.
records.en: Not at all... When I was little, I just wore the clothes Mom bought me, like anyone else.

records.jp: だけど、小学校に上がるくらいの時だったかな？<CR>お母さんの中学時代の友達の人がうちに遊びにきたの
records.en_original: But...maybe it was around when I entered elementary school? A friend of my mom's from middle school came to visit.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe it was around when I entered elementary school? A friend of my mom's from middle school came to visit.
records.en: But... maybe it was around when I entered elementary school? One of Mom's friends from middle school came to visit.

records.jp: その時、その人がドレスをくれて、<CR>それが今までに着たどんな服よりもきれいでかわいくて……
records.en_original: She gave me a dress, and it was cuter and more beautiful than anything I'd ever worn...
records.en_auxiliary: She gave me a dress, and it was cuter and more beautiful than anything I'd ever worn.
records.en: She gave me a dress, and it was cuter and more beautiful than anything I'd ever worn...

records.jp: それを着て鏡に映った姿も自分じゃないみたいで……
records.en_original: When I looked in the mirror, it was like I was a different person...
records.en_auxiliary: When I looked in the mirror, it was like I was a different person.
records.en: When I looked in the mirror, it was like I was a different person...

records.jp: そっか……それがうれしかったんだ……
records.en_original: I see... And you were happy about that...
records.en_auxiliary: I see. And that made you happy?
records.en: I see... And you were happy about that...

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yup.
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: （なんか……昔のしほりがそんなだったのって<CR>今の姿からは想像できないかも……）
records.en_original: (It's hard to imagine Shihori ever being drab, considering how she is now...)
records.en_auxiliary: (It's hard to imagine Shihori ever being a degree of drab, considering how she looks now.)
records.en: (It's hard to imagine Shihori ever being drab, considering how she is now...)

records.jp: ちなみに、そのドレスってどんなやつだったの？
records.en_original: By the way, what kind of dress was it?
records.en_auxiliary: Out of curiosity, what kind of dress was it?
records.en: By the way, what kind of dress was it?

records.jp: おとぎ話に出てくるようなやつだったよ。ひらひらがついてて<CR>真っ白で、とってもキレイでかわいかったの
records.en_original: Something straight out of a fairy tale. It was both beautiful and cute; pure white and frilly.
records.en_auxiliary: Something straight out of a fairy tale. Equal parts beautiful and cute. Pure white and frilly.
records.en: Something straight out of a fairy tale. It was both beautiful and cute; pure white and frilly.

records.jp: へえ……きっと高価なんだろうね
records.en_original: Wow... That must have cost an arm and a leg.
records.en_auxiliary: Wow... That must have cost an arm and a leg.
records.en: Wow... That must have cost an arm and a leg.

records.jp: ううん。そのドレスは売ってるものじゃないの。<CR>その人が私のためにデザインして作ってくれたものなの
records.en_original: Nope. It wasn't something sold in stores. She had designed and made it just for me.
records.en_auxiliary: Nope. It wasn't something sold in stores. She had designed and made it just for me.
records.en: Nope. It wasn't something sold in stores. She had designed and made it just for me.

records.jp: だから、世界に一着しかないと……思う……
records.en_original: So I think it was the only one in the world...
records.en_auxiliary: So I think it must've been the only one in the world.
records.en: So I think it was the only one in the world...

records.jp: へえ、ドレスを自分でデザインするなんてすごいねその人
records.en_original: This friend of your mom's must have been quite something to design and make a dress...
records.en_auxiliary: This friend of your mom's must have been quite talented to design and make a dress.
records.en: This friend of your mom's must have been quite something to design and make a dress...

records.jp: うん。だってその人デザイナーだから……。<CR>しかも昔はモデルもやってたし
records.en_original: Yeah. She was a fashion designer, after all... And before that, a model.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. She was a fashion designer. And before that, she was a model.
records.en: Yeah. She was a fashion designer, after all... And before that, a model.

records.jp: ほんとにきれいで、やさしくて……。<CR>同性の私でも見とれちゃうくらい……
records.en_original: She was beautiful and kind... Even as a girl I found her entrancing...
records.en_auxiliary: She was beautiful and kind... Even as a girl I found her entrancing.
records.en: She was beautiful and kind... Even as a girl I found her entrancing...

records.jp: そうなんだ
records.en_original: Interesting.
records.en_auxiliary: Interesting.
records.en: Interesting.

records.jp: しほり、いろいろ話してくれてありがとう
records.en_original: Thanks for telling me all this, Shihori.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks for sharing all this with me, Shihori.
records.en: Thanks for telling me all this, Shihori.

records.jp: ううん……。大好きな日菜子ちゃんの頼みだから……
records.en_original: Don't mention it... Anything for my beloved Hinako...
records.en_auxiliary: Don't mention it. Anything for my beloved Hinako.
records.en: Don't mention it... Anything for my beloved Hinako-chan...

records.jp: （大好きって……）
records.en_original: (Beloved...?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Beloved?)
records.en: (Beloved...?)

records.jp: はっ！――
records.en_auxiliary: Oh!
